comment: Calibration-fixture flow spec for the Step 3 capture harness integration check. Serve first: 'python -m http.server 8765' from this fixtures dir (HTTP is mandatory - file:// breaks PerformanceObserver; use localhost, not 127.0.0.1). Rubric/readback fields are for Steps 5-6; the capture harness tolerates and echoes them.

rubric.easing: single 300ms eased crossfade (opacity/transform only), settles cleanly with no post-settle movement
rubric.loadingStateIntent: skeleton only if the load exceeds 300ms and then held >= 500ms; default load is instant so no skeleton should ever show

rubric.easing: single eased crossfade expected; stepped/abrupt opacity jumps, blank gaps, or post-settle layout movement are defects
rubric.loadingStateIntent: no spinner should show for an instant load; any spinner shown must respect delay-before-show and minimum display time
